answer: At the wharf, every whisper holds a registration that decays every epoch and must be re-bought by burning one marble per whisper currently moored there. The renewal price is the live count, so n clones held for T epochs cost T·n² in marble; adding the nth clone raises that price for all n, and parallel renewals pay the same count, so splitting wallets does not help. I call this decay-indexed renewal. It breaks if the wharf lets a single marble renew several whispers.
